config_name: iPad Air 13-inch — M4 8-core CPU / 9-core GPU, 12GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 13" Liquid Retina + Magic Keyboard

specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (fully laminated, anti-reflective, no ProMotion)
specs.ports: 1x USB-C (USB 3 10Gb/s, DisplayPort), magnetic Magic Keyboard connector, Smart Connector
specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard for iPad Air 13" included in price: scissor keys with full function row (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total; Pencil USB-C +$99; hover supported

battery.notes: 36.59Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi (9h cellular); users report ~8-8.5h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Tablet-only $2,159.00 (apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard Air 13" $399.99 (BBY 19204078). Cellular variant +$200 ($2,359 tablet). Pencil Pro not included.

reviews.quote: The fiercest competitor for the iPad Pro is home-made. Pros: brute top performance, WiFi very fast, high-quality unibody chassis, USB-C with 10 GBit/s, two external displays possible, good color accuracy (PWM-free), well-balanced speakers, high recycled content. Cons: slow 60 Hz display, battery charging takes time, SoC throttles under sustained load. (NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026; 11" shares SoC and chassis design.)

praises: 1TB internal is the off-grid creator's pick — whole photo/video libraries and offline ProRes caches with no SSD dongle (r/ipad)
M4 media engine (ProRes encode+decode, AV1) punches far above the Air badge in DaVinci/LumaFusion
13" at 616g still leaves every 13" laptop behind on weight with a 10Gb/s data port
Fully laminated anti-reflective 600-nit panel is best-in-class for bright environments among LCD tablets
Function-row Magic Keyboard + 1TB makes it a self-contained field workstation
complaints: $2,559 with keyboard buys the M5 Pro 13" 1TB (tandem OLED, 120Hz, Thunderbolt) for only ~$370 more — reviewers and users both flag this as the Air's pricing dead-end
60Hz LCD at $2,500+ is hard to defend even to Air fans
12GB RAM is the same as the base tier — capacity grew, capability didn't
Unlit keyboard keys; single port still requires a dock for real desk setups
iPadOS remains the ceiling no storage tier fixes

design_philosophy: The top Air tier is where the line's logic runs out: Apple sells capacity, not capability, above 512GB — same M4, same 12GB, same 60Hz LCD. It exists for users who need terabytes of offline storage in a 616g tablet and refuse to dock; everyone else hits diminishing returns against iPad Pro pricing.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026 (87%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Ratings inferred from the 13" M4 256GB line anchor (SHARED-ipad-air.md): identical silicon/display; creative_work +0.6 for 1TB headroom (per SHARED storage-step rule). No verbatim pro score found (bot-walls) — disclosed, none invented. Ecosystem 6.5 per tablets rule; battery ~8.3h real use. Upgradability still 1.0 — soldered. Image URL is BBY CDN best guess (closest-SKU image).
standouts: 1TB of offline pro-app storage in a 616g fanless tablet — nothing else in iPad Air does that
ProRes/AV1 media engine keeps exports fast despite the Air badge
dealbreakers: Within ~$370 of the M5 iPad Pro 13" 1TB with OLED, 120Hz and Thunderbolt — hard sell unless the Air-only colour options matter to you
